data.description:
Two orthogonal modifiers over the existing lifecycle: FLAGGED agents that explicitly request human involvement and jump the queue, and SUPPRESSED agents that reach the operator through no channel at all.

Spec: docs/c11-flagged-agent-plan.md
Staged skill section: docs/c11-attention-model-skill-section.md

## DEPENDS ON C11-183 (mark vocabulary rebuild)

C11-183 must merge first. Every glyph claim here assumes the rebuilt vocabulary, which frees the color channel for the violet recolor. Do not start this before it lands.

## Flagged

- c11 raise-flag --surface <s> "<reason>" / c11 lower-flag --surface <s>; c11 launch-agent --flag "<reason>" for operator-at-dispatch
- Socket: flag.raise, flag.lower, flag.list. Reason REQUIRED on raise (invalid_params if missing).
- Canonical metadata key at the explicit tier in SurfaceMetadataStore, persisting on the existing path.
- Sticky: clears only on operator dismissal or agent lower. Never on read.
- Does NOT write to TerminalNotificationStore (would double-count against the pulse). System notification delivered directly off the raise.
- Arrives from either side, round-trips (violet while up, normal lifecycle colors when lowered), scopes to a moment or a whole mission. Target rarity: at least 9 in 10 agents never flagged.
- Visual: existing mark vocabulary recolored violet, all four states still distinguishable. Flagged+waiting = core-only violet/white hard square wave, 0.4s, inside a steady violet frame. Other flagged states breathe. Flag-tier motion runs regardless of the Static marks setting; Reduce Motion still overrides. Fallback if it fails the latency gate: static violet.

## Suppressed

- c11 suppress / c11 unsuppress --surface <s>; c11 launch-agent --suppressed
- Socket: flag.suppress, flag.unsuppress. Same canonical-metadata path.
- A suppressed surface NEVER enters the waiting state. Lifecycle restricted to working/idle/cold; reads idle on stop.
- NO visual treatment of its own: normal lifecycle colors, no dimming, no badge. Suppression is expressed by which states are reachable.
- Excluded from: waiting count, Waiting Agent button, option-V, system notification, waiting.entered event.
- Notification record IS still written and readable in the notifications list.
- Known cost accepted: a suppressed agent that finished and one that stalled both read as idle.
- Serves the orchestrator/subagent pattern: suppress the children so the orchestrator's signal is the one that reaches the operator.

## Flag overrides suppression outright

A suppressed agent that flags reaches needs-attention and shows the full core-only alarm flash, undimmed, no state restriction, no motion suppression. This is the headline case: "do not tell me when you finish, do tell me if you get stuck."

## Surfaces

1. Flagged Agents sidebar row above Waiting Agent, appearing ONLY when a flag is up. Violet fill, void content, no motion.
2. option-V keeps its binding, gains a priority phase: oldest unlowered flag first (flags are a queue), else latest signal-eligible unread (stack, today's behavior). Do NOT add a second shortcut.
3. In-surface banner with the reason and an X to dismiss. MUST mount in the AppKit portal overlay layer (pattern: NSHostingView<SurfaceSearchOverlay> from GhosttySurfaceScrollView, GhosttyTerminalView.swift:6824). A banner in the layout flow resizes the PTY on every raise/lower and garbles TUI rendering in Claude Code and codex mid-run.
4. System notification on raise: surface title + reason body.

## Projector

Flagged and suppressed become modifier fields on WorkspacePulseAgent, NOT new WorkspacePulseState cases. Renderer receives (state, flagged, suppressed) and composes. WorkspacePulseSummary gains flaggedCount; dominant puts flagged above waiting. Suppressed never resolves to .waiting. Pure functions, covered by c11-logic tests.

## Notification store

- Signal-eligible unread count distinct from raw unread, computed in buildIndexes (TerminalNotificationStore.swift:638)
- emitWaitingEdges fires on the signal-eligible edge
- jumpToLatestUnread (AppDelegate.swift:10361) skips suppressed surfaces

## Events (v1 taxonomy, EventEnvelope.swift:51)

flag.raised {reason}, flag.lowered {by}, flag.suppressed {by}, flag.unsuppressed {by}

The by field distinguishes "seen and deferred" from "nobody looked" so a dismissed agent can decide whether to re-raise.

## Skill

Land docs/c11-attention-model-skill-section.md into skills/c11/SKILL.md IN THIS PR. Per CLAUDE.md hard rule, not done until scripts/sync-installed-skills.sh c11 has run.

## Localization

All new user-facing strings via String(localized:) with English defaultValue only. Spawn a translator pass for the other six locales after the English strings settle.

**synthesis-standard.md** (Analytical Consensus)

**synthesis-adversarial.md** (Critical Findings)

C11-184 terminal code review

Reviewed c11 `e80b807bf5d830ae5a6409a9f35bf9ea0efa93f7` against `origin/main`
`09782511b073953bec7dfcb4ee2d2cc5008c6b2d`, plus Bonsplit
`90ffd2a518d2202e0444a8858c790f126e8e2bc1` and
`02a4feeffac8ca8f8abc68aaff0613ab0319297d`.

Verdict: FAIL

Major findings:

1. The mutating socket timeout is not fail-closed: the main-queue closure can
   commit after the caller receives `main_thread_timeout`.
2. Snapshot restore can install invalid attention values or non-explicit
   canonical sources.
3. Close/prune removes suppression before raw notifications, transiently
   manufacturing waiting edges or leaving stale demand.
4. Active flag-reason revision creates a fresh direct notification identifier
   and accumulates delivered notifications instead of replacing the active one.
5. Bonsplit host presentation ignores `suppressesDefaultMotion == false` and
   freezes default motion for color-only/accessibility-only presentations.
6. The eight new localization keys are absent from `Localizable.xcstrings`.
7. Required behavior coverage is missing for socket ordering, flag.list,
   launch ordering, suppression edges, notification identity, close/prune, and
   portal no-reflow/focus/z-order behavior.
8. The installed c11 skill remains stale.

Minor/integration findings:

- Avoid holding the attention service lock across a main-queue wait.
- Ensure flagged agents remain visible in flagged-dominant detail and expose
  flag/reason accessibility on each compact mark.

No unresolved Critical findings. Core direct flag-over-suppression behavior,
raw-vs-signal indexing, oldest-flag navigation, stickiness, launch
stamp-before-command, event taxonomy, and portal geometry were directionally
correct, subject to the missing integration coverage.

data.body: CI root cause: five new AttentionModelTests instantiate TerminalNotificationStore.shared under bare xctest; its UNUserNotificationCenter.current() initialization throws bundleProxyForCurrentProcess nil before assertions. Focused dependency-injection/testability repair in progress; no local test action will run.

CI repair pushed as a7d13d0688203f500db4493c8aa2681281bcdef1. Root cause: TerminalNotificationStore.shared eagerly called UNUserNotificationCenter.current() in bare c11LogicTests, where no NSApplication bundle exists. The store now lazily enables the real center everywhere except bare XCTest (XCTestConfigurationFilePath present and NSApp nil); notification behavior hooks and all five executable AttentionModelTests remain intact. Verification: c11-logic Debug build-for-testing passed, c11 Debug build passed, c11 Release universal build passed, diff check passed. No xcodebuild test action or app launch was run per task boundary; pushed branch will require CI readback.

Operator decision (2026-07-28): computer-use validation NOT approved for this PR. The tagged-build visual gate (10 screenshot scenarios) and the fleet-scale typing-latency gate (<=1ms p95 across 20 agents / 40+ marks) are DEFERRED, not satisfied. CI green is the merge gate for PR #387.

Consequence to carry forward: flag-tier motion (breathe on flagged working/idle/cold, the 0.4s violet/white core square wave on flagged+waiting) ships unmeasured against the plan's pre-registered latency ladder. The ladder remains available if typing lag is reported: disable stepped fill first, then dip, then ship base marks static; independently, ship flags static violet if flag motion is the culprit.

Also unvalidated visually: the #9D8AD9 violet, which the spec explicitly calls a starting point to be dialled against the live sidebar, and which may need a separate brighter value to hold at 9pt against the #E8E8E8 working mark.
